# Applause Reality

> Bank-approved Delhi NCR property, from first site visit to possession and beyond.

Applause Reality is a Delhi NCR real estate consultancy led by Rajiv Kumar Pandey, with 23+ years guiding families, investors and SBI/PNB banking professionals. It shortlists bank-approved residential and commercial projects in Noida, Greater Noida and Wave City (Ghaziabad), attends site visits, handles booking paperwork, arranges home loans through SBI and PNB relationships, and stays on call after possession. Contact: concierge@applausereality.com, +91 99114 10109.
